claims.claim_text: Under SPP 202, what is the source-safe fee rule when the Architect's work is abandoned or suspended in part?
If the Owner does not implement plans and contract documents prepared by the Architect, what compensation does the checked SPP 202 source support?
Why is an owner-ordered change after approval not treated as unpaid basic work?
What must an LEA answer identify before computing an abandonment-related fee consequence?
When construction is carried out in different periods and the Architect's construction-phase burden increases, what happens to construction-phase charges?
Under the checked SPP 202 wording, what happens if suspension of construction exceeds six months?
Which statement keeps abandonment compensation source-safe?
A client approves drawings, then asks for a different layout before permit filing. Which cost category does SPP 202 support?
What is unsafe in an answer about fees for abandoned projects?
Which fact distinguishes non-implementation compensation from ordinary early-stage abandonment?
